pages.lesson:
LESSON: PHONICS

Grade: Grade 1
Subject: ENGLISH ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 2
Topic 2.2: Phonics

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Phonics. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Phonics
2. Practise Phonics at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Phonics

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Phonics
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Phonics. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Phonics at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Phonics at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Phonics
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Phonics. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Phonics using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Phonics in the examples.
2. Explain Phonics to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Phonics.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Phonics using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Phonics important for a Grade 1 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Phonics
2. Practise Phonics at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Phonics

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
